methods.source: public static function active(){return (int)get_option(self::ENABLED,0)>0;}

public static function fresh($id){wp_cache_delete($id,'post_meta');wp_cache_delete('tkd_fo_order_responsibility_'.$id,'options');wp_cache_delete('notoptions','options');wp_cache_delete('alloptions','options');}

public static function write($id,$key,$v){update_post_meta($id,$key,$v);self::fresh($id);$expected=is_array($v)||is_object($v)?$v:(string)$v;if(get_post_meta($id,$key,true)!==$expected)throw new RuntimeException('Не вдалося зберегти стан '.$id.' / '.$key);}

public static function documents($id){return get_posts(array('post_type'=>'tkd_delivery','post_status'=>array('publish','draft','private','pending'),'posts_per_page'=>-1,'fields'=>'ids','meta_key'=>'_tkd_fo_delivery_order_id','meta_value'=>$id,'no_found_rows'=>true));}
public static function unlock($name){global $wpdb;if($name)$wpdb->get_var($wpdb->prepare('SELECT RELEASE_LOCK(%s)',$name));}

public static function phone($v){$v=preg_replace('/\D+/','',(string)$v);if(strlen($v)===10&&$v[0]==='0')$v='38'.$v;elseif(strlen($v)===11&&substr($v,0,2)==='80')$v='3'.$v;elseif(strlen($v)===9)$v='380'.$v;return preg_match('/^380\d{9}$/',$v)?$v:'';}

public static function basket($id){$items=get_post_meta($id,'_tkd_fo_order_items',true);$out=array();if(!is_array($items)||!$items)return array();foreach($items as $l){if(is_array($l)&&($l['bonus']??'')==='kit_cable'&&in_array($l['sku']??'',array('AWG4-Cu-25-1M-180C','AWG4-CU-25-1M-180C'),true)&&isset($l['unit_price'])&&is_numeric($l['unit_price'])&&(float)$l['unit_price']>=0&&(float)$l['unit_price']<=1&&(float)($l['quantity']??0)===1.0)continue;if(!is_array($l)||empty($l['sku'])||!is_numeric($l['quantity']??null)||!is_finite((float)$l['quantity'])||(float)$l['quantity']<=0)return array();$sku=strtoupper(trim($l['sku']));$out[$sku]=round(($out[$sku]??0)+(float)$l['quantity'],3);}ksort($out);return $out;}

public static function installment($id){if(is_callable(array('TKD_TI_Mono','is_installment'))&&TKD_TI_Mono::is_installment($id))return true;$b=get_post_meta($id,'_tkd_ti_rv_payparts_binding_v1',true);return is_array($b)&&!empty($b['signature'])&&in_array($b['snapshot']['gateway']??'',array('ti_rv_payparts','solar_rv_payparts'),true)&&in_array(get_post_meta($id,'_tkd_fo_order_source',true),array('ti_group','felicity_solar'),true);}

public static function owner_lock(){global $wpdb;$n='tkd_owner_handoff_'.substr(hash('sha256',$wpdb->prefix),0,35);return (string)$wpdb->get_var($wpdb->prepare('SELECT GET_LOCK(%s,0)',$n))==='1'?$n:false;}
private static function hash( $value ) { return hash( 'sha256', serialize( $value ) ); }
private static function sign( $value ) { return hash_hmac( 'sha256', serialize( $value ), wp_salt( 'auth' ) ); }
private static function fail( $message ) { throw new TKD_Sales_Fiscal_Gate_Error( $message ); }
private static function id( $v ) { return ( is_int( $v ) || is_string( $v ) ) && preg_match( '/^[1-9][0-9]*$/D', (string) $v ) && (string) (int) $v === (string) $v ? (int) $v : 0; }
private static function text( $v ) { return is_string( $v ) && trim( $v ) !== ''; }
private static function fresh( $id ) { wp_cache_delete( $id, 'posts' ); wp_cache_delete( $id, 'post_meta' ); }
private static function db_ok() { global $wpdb; return ! isset( $wpdb ) || empty( $wpdb->last_error ); }

private static function meta( $id, $keys ) { $v = array(); foreach ( $keys as $key ) { $v[$key] = get_post_meta( $id, $key, true ); } if ( ! self::db_ok() ) { self::fail( 'Не вдалося перевірити документи в базі даних.' ); } return $v; }
private static function bank_rejected( &$reason, $message ) { $reason = $message; return false; }

private static function result( $state, $message, $fingerprint = '', $number = '', $order = 0 ) { return array( 'state' => $state, 'message' => $message, 'fiscal_number' => $number, 'fingerprint' => $fingerprint !== '' ? $fingerprint : hash( 'sha256', $state . '|' . $message ), 'order_id' => $order ); }
public static function end_office_save( $delivery_id, $lease ) { self::release( $lease ); }
public static function serial_target( $item ) { return TKD_WS_Production::target( $item ); }
private static function manager() { return current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) || current_user_can( 'manage_tkd_felicity' ); }
private static function error( $message ) { return new WP_Error( 'dispatch_blocked', $message ); }
private static function record( $id ) { $s = get_post_meta( $id, self::META, true ); return is_array( $s ) ? $s : array(); }
private static function task( $id ) { $s = get_post_meta( $id, '_tkd_ws_task', true ); return is_array( $s ) ? $s : array(); }
private static function unlock( $name ) { global $wpdb; $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( 'SELECT RELEASE_LOCK(%s)', $name ) ); }

private static function fresh( $id ) { wp_cache_delete( $id, 'post_meta' ); $order = absint( get_post_meta( $id, '_tkd_fo_delivery_order_id', true ) ); wp_cache_delete( $order, 'post_meta' ); $invoice = absint( get_post_meta( $id, '_tkd_fo_delivery_invoice_id', true ) ); wp_cache_delete( $invoice, 'post_meta' ); }
public static function posting_completion_enabled() { return true; }

private static function pickup_enabled() { return self::posting_completion_enabled() || ( is_callable( array( 'TKD_SMS_Service', 'pickup_enabled' ) ) && TKD_SMS_Service::pickup_enabled() === true ); }
private static function fingerprint( $c ) { return hash( 'sha256', wp_json_encode( $c ) ); }
private static function revision( $id, $s, $c ) { return hash_hmac( 'sha256', wp_json_encode( array( $id, $s, $c ) ), wp_salt( 'nonce' ) ); }
private static function uncertain( $s ) { return in_array( $s['challenge']['state'] ?? '', array( 'pending', 'unknown' ), true ) || ! empty( $s['send_unknown'] ); }
private static function error( $message ) { return new WP_Error( 'np_dispatch_blocked', $message ); }
private static function manager() { return current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) || current_user_can( 'manage_tkd_felicity' ); }
private static function id( $v ) { return ( is_string( $v ) || is_int( $v ) ) && preg_match( '/^[1-9][0-9]*$/D', (string) $v ) && (string) (int) $v === (string) $v ? (int) $v : 0; }
private static function text( $id, $key ) { $v = get_post_meta( $id, $key, true ); return is_string( $v ) ? $v : ''; }
private static function record( $id ) { $v = get_post_meta( $id, self::META, true ); return is_array( $v ) ? $v : array(); }
private static function task( $id ) { $v = get_post_meta( $id, '_tkd_ws_task', true ); return is_array( $v ) ? $v : array(); }
private static function option_fresh( $key ) { wp_cache_delete( $key, 'options' ); wp_cache_delete( 'alloptions', 'options' ); wp_cache_delete( 'notoptions', 'options' ); }
private static function option( $key ) { self::option_fresh( $key ); $v = get_option( $key, array() ); return is_array( $v ) ? $v : array(); }
public static function url( $id ) { return self::can( $id ) ? add_query_arg( array( 'action' => 'tkd_np_dispatch', 'delivery_id' => (int) $id ), admin_url( 'admin-post.php' ) ) : ''; }
private static function unlock( $key ) { global $wpdb; $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( 'SELECT RELEASE_LOCK(%s)', $key ) ); }

public static function enabled() { $p = self::option( self::POLICY ); return ( $p['version'] ?? null ) === 1 && ( $p['enabled'] ?? null ) === true && is_array( $p['profiles'] ?? null ) && ! empty( $p['profiles'] ) && self::contract(); }
private static function mode( $order ) { return in_array( self::text( $order, '_tkd_np_delivery_method' ), array( 'nova_warehouse', 'nova_locker', 'nova_courier' ), true ); }
private static function active_post( $id, $type ) { return get_post_type( $id ) === $type && in_array( get_post_status( $id ), array( 'publish', 'draft', 'pending', 'private', 'future' ), true ); }
private static function fingerprint( $c ) { return hash( 'sha256', wp_json_encode( $c ) ); }
private static function revision( $id, $s, $c ) { return hash_hmac( 'sha256', wp_json_encode( array( $id, $s, $c, get_current_user_id() ) ), wp_salt( 'nonce' ) ); }
private static function claim_key( $ttn ) { return self::CLAIM . hash( 'sha256', $ttn ); }
private static function prepost_claim_key( $ttn ) { return self::CLAIM . 'prepost_' . hash( 'sha256', $ttn ); }
private static function claim_value( $c ) { return array( 'version' => 1, 'delivery' => $c['delivery'], 'binding' => $c['binding'], 'fingerprint' => self::fingerprint( $c ) ); }
private static function owns_claim( $c ) { return self::option( self::claim_key( $c['binding']['ttn'] ) ) === self::claim_value( $c ); }
